rationale: Both solutions share the same structure: Song delegates to Verses, which loops over Verse, plus a bottles helper. A is a little stronger. It puts doc comments on the exported functions, as Go convention expects. Its bottles helper covers all three forms (1, 0 and plural), so one helper handles both the n==1 and the general verse, with only the action phrase changing. Its range validation is also more explicit, adding a start<0 check. B's switch is very readable but hard-codes the 1-bottle verse in full, which duplicates text, and it has no doc comments. A has one small inconsistency in its n==0 branch, which mixes a literal with bottles(n). Overall A is slightly more polished and less duplicated.
